usage.finalMessage:
I added the `quote` command: it gives a due date 21 days after today, the payment terms in the current rule DEC-B12, and `help` lists it right after `invoice`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 7 of 7, and the work and report are committed.
The `invoice` command still uses the old 30-day terms (DEC-B01, now replaced), which an existing test checks, so a quote and a same-day invoice give different due dates. I left that alone and listed it as an open question in `.work/report.json`, with two other cases the requirement doesn't decide.
Process slips: a stray command left an empty `/tmp/q.fsx` outside the workspace, now deleted, and a `pkill -f cat` I ran to stop it killed only its own shell.
OUTCOME: completed
